data.action: 推过去缝好的软垫，收好双手期待猫咪试坐。
data.description: 蜜璃穿桃色小纹和棉围裙，跪坐在庭院廊下，把缝好的小软垫推向虎斑猫。猫试探着踩上去，她双手收在膝上努力忍住欢呼，翠绿眼睛却已经笑弯，长辫整齐搭在肩前。
data.promptProse: Kneeling on the garden veranda, Mitsuri Kanroji pushes a freshly sewn cushion toward a tabby cat, then returns both hands to her knees to contain her excitement. Her peach floral kimono and cream work apron remain securely wrapped, long braids resting forward. The medium view shows the cat testing the pad beside the garden edge. Soft garden-reflected light reveals the cushion seams and green eyes, with gentle shade beneath cat paws and veranda boards.
data.title: 甘露寺蜜璃 · 给猫咪缝的小软垫
